description: Find US online therapy and psychiatry services by insurance plan, self-pay price per session, medication prescribing, age group or a word in the name or focus (e.g. 'ADHD', 'couples', 'OCD'). Each result gives the service's cost and insurance answer as its own pages state them, the date checked, and the onlinetherapy.me page with the sources.

age_group.description: Only services that serve this group.

insurance_plan.description: Only services whose own pages name this plan as in network (or that take Medicare / Medicaid).

max_self_pay_per_session_usd.description: Only services whose stated self-pay price for one regular session is at or under this amount.

prescribes_medication.description: true: only services with psychiatric prescribers.

query.description: Words to match in the service's name, other names, parent company or focus, e.g. 'ADHD' or 'Talkspace'.

takes_insurance.description: true: only services that bill insurance in network; false: only self-pay services.

name: search_online_therapy_services
title: Search online therapy and psychiatry services
